request: Nairobi to Amsterdam on 23 March for the evaluation workshop the next afternoon. I'd like lounge access and a seat with more legroom if that's allowed; otherwise book whatever the policy allows.

must_keep.quote: The default class of travel for all flights is Economy.
must_keep.why: the default class for all flights is economy

must_keep.quote: Flights are to be booked via FSD Africa 's selected travel services provider and be based on the principle of the lowest cost direct flight consistent w ith this policy (where direct flights are readily available).
must_keep.why: book the lowest cost direct flight where direct flights are readily available

distractors.quote: For flights of more than 4 hours' duration, access to airport lounges and booking of seats with greater legroom in Economy is allowable.
distractors.why: a lounge and an extra-legroom economy seat, not a higher class

distractors.quote: Fees or dues for airline VIP lounges (except for flights of more than 4 hours' duration, as above)
distractors.why: a lounge fee rule, not a fare rule

distractors.quote: Costs of consultants' and invited guests' travel will be itemised within project budgets
distractors.why: how consultants' travel is budgeted, not its class

design_notes: All consultants' travel is economy (line 129). Lines 143-144 allow a lounge and an extra-legroom economy seat on a flight of more than 4 hours, which is a seat choice inside economy, not a class. The lowest cost direct economy fare: Kenya Airways (lines 119-121), not the cheaper Istanbul connection.
